facts.name: CompositeSDRForeground_UpdateViewUB_SetViewport_ForTarget
facts.note: The composite-foreground pass's per-draw setup: the view's uniform buffer rewritten for the target's extent, then an FRHICommandSetViewport (0,0)-(W,H) appended to the command list (its link then points at the command's Next field). Same prologue (push rbp; push rbx; push rsi; push rdi; push r14; push r15; lea rbp,[rsp-14A8h]) and body in both builds.
